notes: Version 11.27. The update loop is now stopped for good, even on machines updating from 11.24 or 11.25. When this version first lands, it leaves a small watcher behind: if the update ever fails and rolls back, the watcher counts it itself, and after two counted rollbacks it settles that version - no more automatic retries, the working version keeps running, and the door opens again by itself the moment a newer version is published. The 11.25 fixes are all still here: the rollback backoff, the single-updater lock with its per-try fingerprint, the preload fix, the readable buttons, and the repaired windows. The phone build stays at 11.9.12.
